content: Overnight shift bugs: naive date-boundary logic splits one continuous overnight shift into two calendar-day records, corrupting overtime rules that trigger on daily totals and forcing manual reconciliation. Correct approach: compute worked duration by adding 24h to end time when end < start (e.g. 22:00-06:00 = (06:00+24)-22:00 = 8h) and attribute the shift to a single logical work-date (usually the start date) rather than splitting at midnight.
